sources.note: No stress/accent statement found: 'accent' occurs only as tone-diacritic names (p.55), 'mettre l'accent sur' (pp.92,247,301) and a Creissels framework line '(accent ou tons)' (p.25); 'accent tonique', 'accentuation', 'syllabe accentuee', 'intensite', 'proeminence', 'suprasegmental' = 0 hits. Ch.3 p.54: 'le ngbem est un parler a tons. Les variations de hauteur de la voix sont utilisees a des fins distinctives'; three level tonemes H/M/B, contour tones non-phonemic (pp.55-58); ch.4 syllable structure without accent; p.255: three phonological tones in both Gangam lects (ngbem, and dye per Kelly…

sources.citation: Reimer, A. Jeanette. 2022. The Segmental Phonology and Tonology of Dye (Gangam) and its Verb Classification System. SIL e-Books 80. Dallas: SIL International. xiii+323 pp. (SIL archive entry 94779; PDF downloaded via the Internet Archive because live sil.org is behind an automated-access block)
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing: the words stress/accent/prominence do not occur in the body text of the 336-page phonology (only 'Accentology' in a reference title). Prosody is treated entirely as tone: sec. 1.1.3 (p.3) three phonemic tones H, M, L, lexical tone on nearly all morphemes; sec. 1.2 TBU = sonorous portion of the rime; ch.3 'Phonotactics, Syllables, and Prosody' = contour-tone licensing by syllable type, syllable weight (p.94) discussed only for three-pitch contours; ch.6 tonal processes and downstep.

sources.note: Nothing; morphosyntactic overview (Gando dialect) in Fleming's stratificational model; tone mentioned only for orthographic marking and aspect marking on verbs (refers to Kelly 1993 ms 'Tonal processes in Gangam').

sources.note: Unpublished 1986 SIL Togo phonology ms by the author of the 2022 Dye (Gangam) tonology, listed only in Reimer 2022 Appendix D; not in the SIL public archive/OLAC listing for gng, not in Glottolog. Its tone coverage is unknown: tone was treated at the time in a separate ms (Walker & Nicole, 'Les tons du gangam: etude preliminaire' = known Nicole & Walker 1983), so this item may be largely segmental; in any case superseded by Reimer 2022 (three level tonemes H, M, L).
